title: Pinnacle SMP
description: Pinnacle SMP is a Vanilla+ Minecraft server that got its start in 2012 when McCreeper1318 started hosting a public Minecraft server.
body:
## WHO WE ARE

![PinnacleSMP](https://res.cloudinary.com/ds4p9jsuf/image/upload/v1780430105/94ED434F-0A09-4D1B-9E18-B5B4B9248641_fbtaz7.png)

Pinnacle SMP is a small, history rich Minecraft community that has been around since 2012. We have primarily focused on a pure vanilla Minecraft experience with an emphasis on community.

Recently we have started being a vanilla+ server with only quality of life plugins, still focusing on the core vanilla experience.

## OUR COMMUNITY

![Season 11](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ao2BZbcL/images/2b70bbac22e5d9fba3668cfd4e9163ec36f2cd55.png)

We have a vibrant, diverse, and small community of friends who play Minecraft and talk about different things in our discord server. Unlike the "mega servers" where you are just a number, as a member of Pinnacle you become part of the community and friends with our other members.

## HOW TO JOIN

If you are 18+ and would like to join us, you can go to our website at https://www.pinnacle.org and apply to be whitelisted. There may be a short interview process through discord to make sure you are a good fit for our community and that we are a good fit for you.

## Season 12 Overview

**Season Start:** Season 12 began in April 2026, marking a world reset and a new chapter for the server. As with previous seasons, the focus is on long-term world building, player-driven projects, and organic progression.

**World Setup:** The world is currently running as a pure vanilla survival experience. A transition to Paper 26.1.2 was planned but it was voted by the community recently to wait for Paper 26.2.

**World Border:** Currently the world border is set to 4000 blocks across. This is to create a more condensed world to encourage player interaction, shared infrastructure and a more connected community layout in the early game. The world border is not permanent. A server vote may take place at a later date to determine whether it should be expanded or removed.

**Spawn Town Development:** Spawn is currently in active development as everyone begins shaping the central hub of the world. Rather than being pre-built, spawn town is community-driven, reflecting the style and creativity of active players. It is encouraged to set up your first starter home in town and even open up some shops there down the line.
